summary.TTCS_caveat: This is a LOCAL identity-pairing angular difference, not the globally Green-projected inter-node coefficient c_opp - c_same. The full source-to-receiver transfer matrix includes Bianchi correction, kernel projection, product spectral pseudo-inverse, node-frame transport, and radial extraction. Cancellation in the Green projection is mathematically possible but not proved or disproved.
summary.what_is_established: H^4_+(zeta) and H^4_-(zeta) are generically different symmetric 2-tensors. Their radial obstruction overlap differs by 4(1-p_2^2), which has definite sign >= 0 and mean 8/3 on S^3. This is a necessary INPUT to the inter-node Green response computation but not its OUTPUT.
summary.decisive_remaining_computation: Compute the full product Lichnerowicz Green transfer from source node to receiver node in the C_{ab} basis, including all 9 tensor components, Bianchi/gauge correction, kernel projection, and evaluate c_opp - c_same as a single real number.
